description: Remove hidden details from photos before sharing: GPS location, camera, dates, author, XMP edit history, IPTC captions, comments and AI labels / Content Credentials (C2PA). JPEG, PNG and WebP are cleaned losslessly (the picture itself is not re-saved); other formats (HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, GIF) are re-saved without metadata. Reports what each file was hiding. Saved as name-clean.ext next to the original.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

fix_orientation.description: Instead of keeping the rotation tag, turn the pixels upright and re-save (quality 95, not lossless). Only affects photos that have a rotation tag.

keep_colour_profile.description: ICC colour profiles hold no personal data. Removing one can make wide-gamut photos look dull. Default true.

keep_rotation.description: Phone photos often store their rotation as metadata. Keeping this one tag (re-written alone) stops them turning sideways. Default true.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

name: clean_metadata
title: Remove hidden metadata
